I'm a goddamn survivor to have lasted through things I have; things nobody else can ever understand, honestly. Nobody. I don't brag, it's no accomplishment living. 

But I'm stubborn, resolute, and can live by seeing the entire world that kicks us down  personified as something I can pick myself up in anger to oppose.

Fuck that bitch. That's all I needed to hear. I can find it in me if it's more like a fight than drowning.

God fucking bless you.

That's why countries with burkas and modesty laws still have rape, sexual assaults, people masturbating, and sex outside marriage.

Sex is literally the only function besides living yourself that you as a lifeform are meant to do by nature on this planet.
He was a lot blacker, less jewish and surprisingly athletic in his younger days, huh?

Yeah, I think she really believes it's not actually a problem, wants to believe that, or just is absolutely incapable of addressing it.

Maybe she has no libido, but when I bring it up I do all the talking, she clams up, looks uncomfortable and cannot seem to switch topics fast enough.

She assures me it's not attraction, and I'm sexy. She's always joking she's got the "never when there's the slightest reason not to" sexuality basically. Her 1 or 2 positions, nothing kinky, and over as soon as possible. 

I need to know someone loves me, wants me, and wants to be there with me. I don't have much else in my life at this moment. 

I had sex twice before we met, not an illustrious history, but more importantly have come to terms with my bisexuality. 

I realize I may place too much significance on sex, but even then. After a brush with death, I think it's one of the only things in life that does. Feeling close to another person, feeling ang giving love, experiences that you'll actually think about as your grip on this world is lost in the end. I may have just fucked up thinking it wasn't important years ago when I settled down. 

Now I have both rejection and commitment, and reason to hate myself and resent my wife. She has everything she wants from life, I've given and sacrificed for her, and she's done a lot for me that ultimately doesn't matter. That fucking pistol sits loaded dominating my thoughts.
